1: [Gospel of Mary 4:1-7 — The Saviour's parting word]

And the Saviour said: Go then, preach the gospel of the kingdom. Do not lay down any law beyond what I have laid down, nor give a command as the lawgiver does, lest you be held fast by it. And after He had said this He departed from them.
[Gospel of Mary 4:9-11 — Grief at the door]
But they were grieved, and wept greatly, saying: How shall we go to the Gentiles to preach the gospel of the kingdom? If they did not spare Him, how will they spare us?

Then Mary stood up, and greeted them all, and said to her brethren: Do not weep and grieve, nor let your hearts be troubled, for His grace will be with you all, and will shelter you. Rather let us praise His greatness, for He has made us glad and made us men.
2: When Mary had said this, she fell silent, since it was to this point that the Saviour had spoken with her. But Andrew answered and said to the brethren: Say what you wish about what she has said. I at least do not believe that the Saviour said this. For certainly these teachings are strange ideas.

She saw the Lord in a vision and said to Him: Lord, now I see You. And He answered and said to her: Blessed are you, that you did not waver at the sight of Me. For where the mind is, there is the treasure.
[Gospel of Mary 7:1-3 — The seed of the soul]

The soul said: I am at rest, for the time of rest has come for me, and I have seen what was hidden. Do not think that I speak from the world; for I speak from the mind which is in me, and my word is true.
3: Then Levi answered and said to Peter: Peter, you are always hot-tempered. Now I see you contending against the woman like the adversaries. But if the Saviour made her worthy, who are you then, that you should reject her? Assuredly the Saviour knows her very well.

That is why He loved her more than us. Rather let us be ashamed, and put on the perfect man, and be clothed with His worthiness, and let us preach the gospel, not laying down any rule nor law beyond what the Saviour said.
When Mary had said this, they began to go out, and to preach to the people, and to proclaim the gospel of the kingdom, as the Saviour had commanded them. And the gospel she gave them was her own.
